title: School and nursery health check
what: A pediatrician and other doctors examine your child and fill in a medical record for school or nursery. Vaccines and general health are checked.
why: Before starting nursery or school for the first time, or when moving to another one.
duration: usually a few days or weeks to see all doctors and do tests; the pediatrician completes the form at the last visit
tell_doctor: Your child's long-term conditions and medicines
Allergies, especially to food and stings
If your child sees any specialists

prepare.title: Start early
prepare.text: Begin 1 to 2 months ahead, so you can see all the doctors without rush.

prepare.title: Checklist
prepare.text: Ask the clinic for the list of doctors and tests. It depends on age.

prepare.title: Your child
prepare.text: Tell your child the doctors will look and listen, without scary words.

bring: The form from the school or nursery, if given
steps: The pediatrician gives you a list of doctors and tests
You see the specialists: usually an eye doctor, ENT, neurologist, surgeon, and dentist
The pediatrician collects the reports and completes the medical record
feel: Only the blood test is unpleasant
after: Give the medical record to the school or nursery nurse
If vaccines are due, they are given on schedule
If a doctor found something, you will be told what to do next

faq.q: Will my child be accepted without vaccines?
faq.a: Rules depend on the country and the school. Check with your clinic and the nursery.

faq.q: Can it all be done in one day?
faq.a: Sometimes, yes. Some clinics have such programs. Ask in advance.

reminders.text: School or nursery health check tomorrow. Bring the vaccination record and your child's documents.
